findings.issue: No test covers R1's default directory, configs/demo/sections, because every test sets NL_DEMO_SECTIONS_DIR. Attempt 1 already flagged this and it is still open. It is acceptable for T2 because T4 scenario 9 exercises the real sections.
findings.fix: Optional: add a test that points NL_DEMO_SECTIONS_DIR at ../../configs/demo/sections with the demo mappings and asserts that both real recipes load. Alternatively, leave this to T4.

findings.issue: The symlink containment subtests call t.Skipf when os.Symlink fails. On a host without symlink support, the attempt-1 fix would go unverified without any visible failure. It works on Linux CI, where the tests ran and passed.
findings.fix: Optional: use t.Fatalf on Linux, or accept as is.

requirements_checked.evidence: loadRecipes/loadRecipesFromRoot (recipe.go, diff lines 91-140) read only top-level *.yaml files in name order through os.Root. Errors are wrapped as 'section recipe <file>: <reason>'. The default directory is set at service.go:defaultSectionsDir. Proven by TestScenario1InvalidRecipeStopsStartup (6 subtests, each asserting bad.yaml plus the reason) and TestScenario1ValidRecipeLoads. These pass in checks/T2-a2.log and in my local re-run.

rawRecipe, rawField and verbatimDef are plain tagged structs. decimalText is the only UnmarshalYAML, and KnownFields(true) is set in loadRecipeFile. A second YAML document is now rejected. Proven by the unknown_key, unknown_field_key, unknown_verbatim_key (flow mapping) and missing_id subtests, and by TestLoadRecipeRejectsSecondYAMLDocument.

fieldDef.validate looks up source, target and prior (when set) and returns '<key>: unknown mapped field <name>' when GetField is nil. Proven by TestScenario1InvalidRecipeStopsStartup/unknown_mapped_field against a real mapping.Store from bootstrap.LoadMappings. With a nil store, TestNewWithRecipesRequiresStore asserts both the file name and 'mapping store is not available'.

service.Sections() returns all five SectionInfo fields sorted by ID. TestScenario8SectionsSortedByID uses one.yaml=b-second and two.yaml=a-first, so file order and ID order differ, and it compares full structs.

TestScenario1InvalidRecipeStopsStartup (unknown key, missing id, unknown mapped field, plus unknown field/verbatim keys and an empty verbatim file) and TestScenario1ValidRecipeLoads pass. All checks/T2-a2.json commands exit 0, including golangci-lint.

requirements_checked.evidence: In New (service.go), the override is applied only when Cfg != nil && !DemoMode and the value is non-blank, and the value is trimmed. It is documented on New, and the ID is never logged. Proven by the TestDocumentIDOverrideFromEnvironment subtests nil_cfg_keeps_yaml, demo_mode_keeps_yaml, sandbox_uses_env, sandbox_trims_env, sandbox_unset_keeps_yaml and sandbox_blank_keeps_yaml. configs/demo is untouched.

requirements_checked.requirement: L0 contract: New succeeds with no recipes
requirements_checked.evidence: A missing directory returns nil, and an empty directory loads zero and closes the root. Proven by TestNewSucceedsWithoutRecipes (empty and missing, demoenv.Env{}) and by go test -race -run '^TestDemoPipeline' ./cmd/workiva-mcp/ (exit 0). A non-directory path errors, per TestNewRejectsSectionsPathThatIsAFile.

requirements_checked.requirement: Fix from review of attempt 1: os.OpenRoot containment plus a symlink test
requirements_checked.evidence: loadRecipes opens the directory with os.OpenRoot. verbatimDef.validate stats files through root.Stat, and the root is kept on recipeDef for T4. TestLoadRecipeVerbatimContainment covers parent_element (with a real outside file), absolute, symlink_file_outside and symlink_dir_outside. The symlink cases assert 'escapes', which only os.Root produces, so they would fail without the fix. TestLoadRecipeAllowsSymlinkInsideSectionsDir accepts an internal symlink.

The code diff touches only owned files (recipe.go, service.go, service_test.go, testdata/load/**). The New signature is unchanged, test helpers use the loadTest prefix, and no test asserts Prepare or LatestFacts results. The vocabulary (section recipe, field, verbatim block, section) matches CONTEXT.md.
